title: Book Two · Chapter 193: The Visitor Who Has No Packet
story:
On the third Wednesday, Ronan helps prepare pages at the public table. Miss Wu is nearby. A younger boy comes through the door with an empty paper cover.

“My class got the picture packets,” he says. “Mine is empty.”

Ronan looks inside. There is only a name card. “Which class are you in?” he asks. The boy tells him. Ronan finds that class on the collection sheet.

That row shows thirteen packets collected. One packet stayed here for a cover repair. Ronan recognises his own note about packet eleven from last week.

“Your teacher collected thirteen,” he says. “One packet was not ready. Let me check where the repaired one is now.”

The boy looks worried. “Did I lose mine?”

“The record shows one was still here. I cannot tell from this cover alone.”

Ronan puts the cover beside the collection sheet. He asks Miss Wu about the repair tray. She shows him the completed packet. Its cover is secure now.

“Is this for the boy's class?” Ronan asks.

She checks the class row. It is the right packet for his class. Then she puts a new note on the sheet. She hands the packet to the boy herself.

Ronan points to the number inside. “That is eleven. Check that number with your teacher.”

The boy looks at the picture. His face relaxes. He asks if he can take a second packet for his friend.

“We need to check with your teacher first,” Miss Wu says. “Please ask your friend to bring the class note.”

The boy thanks them and leaves with one packet. Ronan returns the empty cover to the teacher-check tray. Miss Wu still needs to check the cover. The boy has his packet now. That does not mean Ronan can throw the old cover away.

Miss Wu finishes the record. She asks Ronan to read the note from last week and the new note together.

He does. The first shows the missing packet. The second shows the boy took the packet today. Both dates are clear.

“The next person can follow that,” she says.

Ronan smiles. He wrote the note last week. Today it saved time at the public table. They did not need to search every shelf again.

At the end of the hour, he meets the younger boy again in the yard. The boy has a friend beside him. He holds up the packet, then runs toward the gate.

Ronan lifts his hand. He is glad the packet is in use. He is also glad he did not promise a second one.

At home, he opens his storybook while Mum finishes a work note. She asks him to wait for tea. She brings the tea when he is halfway through a page. He asks her to leave the cup beside his elbow.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

recognise＝认出；cover＝封皮；completed＝已完成的；relax＝放松下来。

## 理解问题

1. 上周的准确记录怎样帮助处理这周的真实问题？
2. Ronan为什么没有自己答应给男孩第二份材料？

## 读句子

**It is the right packet for his class.**

拆开看：It / is the right packet / for his class.

它／是／他班级需要的那份材料。
